scope: Selected biochemical reference chains for network interpretation. These links are not inferred network edges, do not imply flux, and do not establish same-organism pathway completeness.

chains.label: Nitrogen-oxide reduction: Nap branch
chains.limit: Selected Nap/cNOR architecture. Other architectures remain separate. Community co-detection does not demonstrate complete denitrification within an organism.

chains.label: Nitrogen-oxide reduction: Nar/Nxr-ambiguous branch
chains.limit: Historical Nar/Nxr KOs do not resolve nitrate reduction versus nitrite oxidation. This is a contextual alternative, not an independent pathway confirmation.

chains.label: Nitrate-to-ammonium components: Nap/NrfAH branch
chains.limit: NrfH represents one architecture; failure of this branch is not absence of all DNRA. Community genes may come from different organisms.

chains.label: Assimilatory nitrate-reduction components
chains.limit: Alternative enzymes remain within each step. Community co-detection does not establish flux into biomass.

chains.label: Acetyl-CoA / acetate interconversion
chains.limit: The Pta-AckA branch is reversible. Reference order does not identify net acetate production or consumption.

chains.label: CO2-linked methane-pathway components
chains.limit: Carbon-transfer steps are ordered from the reference. Heterodisulfide recycling is reported separately. Mcr and community co-detection do not resolve methane production, oxidation or related alkyl-CoM metabolism.

chains.label: Acetate-linked methane-pathway components
chains.limit: Acetate activation alternatives and shared acetyl-CoA machinery do not prove methane production. Heterodisulfide recycling is not an extra carbon-chain step.

chains.label: Sulfate / sulfite / reduced-sulfur machinery
chains.limit: Sat/Apr/Dsr assignments are shared with oxidative pathways. This is a partial machinery screen; DsrC-associated chemistry and electron-transfer context are not replaced by the DsrAB marker. It is not complete sulfate respiration.
